WITH b AS (
  SELECT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d, vertical AS v,
         sum(CASE WHEN source = 'tickets' AND flg_human = true THEN ticket_count END) AS h,
         sum(CASE WHEN source = 'tickets' AND flg_retention_bot = true THEN ticket_count END) AS bot,
         sum(CASE WHEN source = 'experiencia' AND metric = 'csat' THEN promoter_like_count END) AS cl,
         sum(CASE WHEN source = 'experiencia' AND metric = 'csat' THEN coalesce(neutral_count, 0) + coalesce(detractor_dislike_count, 0) END) AS cx
  FROM prod.cx.agg_overview
  WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5)
    AND CAST(date AS DATE) < current_date()
    AND coalesce(friendly_service_channel, '') <> 'derivacao'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'dia' AS grao, CAST(d AS STRING) AS periodo, v AS vertical, h, bot, cl, cx
FROM b WHERE d >= date_sub(current_date(), 14)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'semana', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('week', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), v, sum(h), sum(bot), sum(cl), sum(cx)
FROM b WHERE d >= date_sub(CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE), 70) AND d < CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE)
GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mes', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('month', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), v, sum(h), sum(bot), sum(cl), sum(cx)
FROM b GROUP BY 2, 3

WITH b AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN survey_type = 'relacional' THEN 'rel'
         ELSE CASE action_name
           WHEN 'nps transacional pix out - wallet' THEN 'pix'
           WHEN 'nps transacional pix out - cc' THEN 'pixcc'
           WHEN 'nps transacional cartão rp' THEN 'cartao'
           WHEN 'nps transacional loans' THEN 'emprestimo'
           WHEN 'nps transacional loans consignado' THEN 'consignado'
           WHEN 'nps transacional tap' THEN 't2p'
           WHEN 'nps transacional cdb' THEN 'cdb'
           WHEN 'nps transacional transport' THEN 'transp'
           WHEN 'nps transacional link pagamento' THEN 'link'
           WHEN 'nps transacional topup' THEN 'topup'
           WHEN 'nps transacional utilities' THEN 'boletos'
           ELSE 'x' END END AS pk,
         survey_type AS st, CAST(review AS DOUBLE) AS r, CAST(answer_date AS DATE) AS d
  FROM prod.cx.fat_indecx_metrics
  WHERE metric = 'nps-0-10' AND deleted IS NOT TRUE AND survey_type IN ('transacional', 'relacional') AND review IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(answer_date AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5)
    AND CAST(answer_date AS DATE) < current_date()
    AND NOT (survey_type = 'relacional' AND action_name LIKE 'relacional de cc%')
), u AS (
  SELECT pk, d, r FROM b WHERE pk <> 'x'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'geral', d, r FROM b WHERE st = 'transacional'
)
SELECT 'dia' AS grao, CAST(d AS STRING) AS periodo, pk AS chave, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN r >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prom, sum(CASE WHEN r <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS det
FROM u WHERE d >= date_sub(current_date(), 14) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'semana', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('week', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), pk, count(*), sum(CASE WHEN r >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN r <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM u WHERE d >= date_sub(CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE), 70) AND d < CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mes', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('month', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), pk, count(*), sum(CASE WHEN r >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN r <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM u GROUP BY 2, 3

WITH r0 AS (
  SELECT 'loja' AS src, CAST(rating AS DOUBLE) AS nota, 'loja' AS cl, concat_ws(' ', title, content) AS txt, CAST(review_date AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM prod.cx.fat_app_reviews
  WHERE brand = 'RecargaPay' AND length(content) > 15
    AND CAST(review_date AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5) AND CAST(review_date AS DATE) < current_date()
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rede', CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), coalesce(sentiment, 'sem sentimento'), content, CAST(created_at AS DATE)
  FROM prod.cx.fat_buzzmonitor_posts
  WHERE type IN ('comment', 'comment_reply', 'mention', 'comment_from_mention', 'review', 'COMMENT', 'REPLY', 'reply', 'reels')
    AND length(trim(coalesce(content, ''))) > 15 AND coalesce(only_emojis, false) = false
    AND CAST(created_at AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5) AND CAST(created_at AS DATE) < current_date()
), r1 AS (
  SELECT *, lower(translate(coalesce(txt, ''), 'áàâãäéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüç', 'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuuc')) AS t FROM r0
), pr AS (
  SELECT src, nota, cl, dd, 'geral' AS prod FROM r1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT src, nota, cl, dd, p FROM (
    SELECT src, nota, cl, dd, stack(12,
      'cartao', t RLIKE '(?<!pix com )(?<!pix no )(?<!pix pelo )cartao(?! de (transporte|bilhete|vale))|fatura|anuidade|mastercard|rotativo|limite do cartao',
      'emprestimo', t RLIKE 'emprestimo(?! consignado)|financiamento|renegoc|credito pessoal|saque aniversario|pagar depois',
      'pix', t RLIKE '(^|[^a-z])pix([^a-z]|$)|chave pix|qr ?code|copia e cola',
      'conta', t RLIKE 'cadastr|abrir (a |minha )?conta|abertura de conta|criar (a |minha )?conta|criacao de conta|kyc|validacao (de )?(documento|identidade)|selfie|conta (nao )?(aprovada|negada|recusada)',
      'fraude', t RLIKE 'carteira.{0,30}bloque|bloque.{0,30}carteira|saldo.{0,30}bloque|bloque.{0,30}saldo|bloquearam (minha |a )?(conta|carteira)|bloqueou (minha |a )?(conta|carteira)|conta bloquead|bloqueio (da|na|de) (conta|carteira)|chargeback|contestac|contestei|contestar|estorno|estornaram|disputa|nao reconheco (a )?compra|compra (indevida|nao reconhec)|cobranca indevida',
      'transp', t RLIKE 'transporte|bilhete|onibus|metro|passagem|sptrans|urbs|cptm|(^|[^a-z])brt([^a-z]|$)',
      't2p', t RLIKE 'tap ?to ?pay|tap ?on ?phone|tap2pay|maquinin|maquina de cartao|mpos|receber por aproximacao',
      'cdb', t RLIKE 'investi|cdb|cofrinho|rendiment|rende|poupanca|renda fixa|cdi|(^|[^a-z])aplicar',
      'seguros', t RLIKE 'seguro (de |do |para |)?(vida|celular|residencial|auto|carro|viagem|prestamista|saude|desemprego)|(contratei|contratar|cancelar|cancelei|cobranca d?o?|desconto d?o?) seguro|apolice|sinistro|seguradora|prestamista',
      'boletos', t RLIKE 'boleto|conta de (luz|agua|gas|telefone|internet)|pagar conta|pagamento de conta|codigo de barras|darf|iptu|ipva|debito automatico',
      'link', t RLIKE 'link de pagamento|link pay|payment link|link de cobranca|cobrar por link|link para cobrar',
      'topup', t RLIKE 'recarga.{0,15}(celular|vivo|claro|tim|oi)|(vivo|claro|tim|oi) recarga|operadora|recarregar (o )?celular|credito (no|do|de) celular|creditos? celular'
    ) AS (p, v) FROM r1
  ) z WHERE v
), m AS (
  SELECT src, prod, dd,
         count(*) AS n,
         sum(CASE WHEN (src = 'loja' AND nota >= 4) OR (src = 'rede' AND cl = 'positive') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pos,
         sum(CASE WHEN (src = 'loja' AND nota <= 2) OR (src = 'rede' AND cl = 'negative') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg
  FROM pr GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT src, 'semana' AS grao, CAST(CAST(date_trunc('week', dd) AS DATE) AS STRING) AS periodo, prod AS produto, sum(n) AS n, sum(pos) AS pos, sum(neg) AS neg
FROM m WHERE dd >= date_sub(CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE), 70) AND dd < CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE) GROUP BY 1, 3, 4
UNION ALL
SELECT src, 'mes', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('month', dd) AS DATE) AS STRING), prod, sum(n), sum(pos), sum(neg)
FROM m GROUP BY 1, 3, 4

WITH b AS (
  SELECT CAST(creation_date AS DATE) AS d, lower(coalesce(vertical, '')) AS v,
         lower(translate(concat_ws(' ', complaint_title, complaint_content), 'áàâãéêíóôõúç', 'aaaaeeiooouc')) AS t,
         CASE WHEN resolved_issue THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resolvida,
         CASE WHEN hugme_status IN ('Respondido', 'Réplica da empresa', 'Finalizado', 'Avaliado') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS respondida,
         CASE WHEN rating IS NOT NULL AND rating <> '-1' THEN CAST(rating AS DOUBLE) END AS nota
  FROM prod.cx.fat_hugme_tickets
  WHERE CAST(creation_date AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5) AND CAST(creation_date AS DATE) < current_date()
), p AS (
  SELECT d, resolvida, respondida, nota,
    CASE WHEN v LIKE 'cart%' THEN 'cartao' WHEN v LIKE 'empr%' THEN 'emprestimo' WHEN v LIKE 'pix%' THEN 'pix'
         WHEN v LIKE 'minha conta%' THEN 'conta' WHEN v IN ('conta desativada', 'carteira desativada', 'chargeback recovery') THEN 'fraude'
         WHEN v LIKE '%seguro%' OR v LIKE 'prote%' THEN 'seguros' WHEN v LIKE 'tap%' THEN 't2p' WHEN v LIKE 'cdb%' OR v LIKE '%invest%' THEN 'cdb'
         WHEN v LIKE 'transp%' THEN 'transp' WHEN v LIKE 'link%' THEN 'link' WHEN v LIKE 'contas%' OR v LIKE 'boleto%' OR v LIKE 'utilit%' THEN 'boletos'
         WHEN v LIKE 'recarga%' THEN 'topup'
         WHEN t RLIKE 'anuidade|fatura' THEN 'cartao' WHEN t RLIKE 'emprestimo' THEN 'emprestimo' WHEN t RLIKE 'bloque|encerr|desativ|retid' THEN 'fraude'
         WHEN t RLIKE '(^|[^a-z])pix([^a-z]|$)' THEN 'pix' WHEN t RLIKE 'cadastr|selfie|acessar|login|senha' THEN 'conta' WHEN t RLIKE 'seguro' THEN 'seguros'
         WHEN t RLIKE 'boleto|cashback' THEN 'boletos' WHEN t RLIKE 'bilhete|transporte|onibus' THEN 'transp' WHEN t RLIKE 'maquin|tap to pay' THEN 't2p'
         WHEN t RLIKE 'cdb|investiment|rendiment' THEN 'cdb' ELSE 'outros' END AS produto
  FROM b
), u AS (
  SELECT d, produto, resolvida, respondida, nota FROM p
  UNION ALL SELECT d, 'total', resolvida, respondida, nota FROM p
)
SELECT 'dia' AS grao, CAST(d AS STRING) AS periodo, produto, count(*) AS n, sum(resolvida) AS resolvidas, sum(respondida) AS respondidas, sum(nota) AS nota_soma, count(nota) AS nota_n
FROM u WHERE d >= date_sub(current_date(), 14) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'semana', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('week', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), produto, count(*), sum(resolvida), sum(respondida), sum(nota), count(nota)
FROM u WHERE d >= date_sub(CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE), 70) AND d < CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mes', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('month', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), produto, count(*), sum(resolvida), sum(respondida), sum(nota), count(nota)
FROM u GROUP BY 2, 3

         CAST(answer_date AS DATE) AS d, CASE WHEN CAST(review AS DOUBLE) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pos, CAST(review AS INT) AS nota,

WITH tp AS (
  SELECT CAST(rp_user_id AS STRING) AS u,
         CASE max(CASE credit_type WHEN 'INVESTMENT' THEN 3 WHEN 'GRANTED' THEN 2 WHEN 'COLLATERAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN 3 THEN 'cc_i' WHEN 2 THEN 'cc_c' WHEN 1 THEN 'cc_g' END AS sub
  FROM prod.credit_card.dim_card_account WHERE rp_user_id > 0 GROUP BY 1
), t AS (
  SELECT CAST(created_at_br AS DATE) AS d, CAST(userid AS STRING) AS u,
         CASE WHEN flg_human THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS h, CASE WHEN flg_retention_bot THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bot
  FROM prod.cx.dim_zendesk_tickets_summary
  WHERE lower(vertical) LIKE 'cartão de crédito%' AND coalesce(friendly_service_channel, '') <> 'derivacao'
    AND CAST(created_at_br AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5) AND CAST(created_at_br AS DATE) < current_date()
), ts AS (
  SELECT t.d, coalesce(tp.sub, 'cc_x') AS sub, sum(t.h) AS h, sum(t.bot) AS bot FROM t LEFT JOIN tp ON t.u = tp.u GROUP BY 1, 2
), nn AS (
  SELECT CAST(m.answer_date AS DATE) AS d, coalesce(tp.sub, 'cc_x') AS sub, CAST(m.review AS DOUBLE) AS r
  FROM prod.cx.fat_indecx_metrics m LEFT JOIN tp ON CAST(m.user_id AS STRING) = tp.u
  WHERE m.metric = 'nps-0-10' AND m.deleted IS NOT TRUE AND m.survey_type = 'transacional' AND m.action_name = 'nps transacional cartão rp' AND m.review IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.answer_date AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5) AND CAST(m.answer_date AS DATE) < current_date()
), ns AS (
  SELECT d, sub, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN r >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prom, sum(CASE WHEN r <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS det FROM nn GROUP BY 1, 2
), u AS (
  SELECT d, sub, h, bot, 0 AS n, 0 AS prom, 0 AS det FROM ts
  UNION ALL SELECT d, sub, 0, 0, n, prom, det FROM ns
)
SELECT 'dia' AS grao, CAST(d AS STRING) AS periodo, sub, sum(h) AS h, sum(bot) AS bot, sum(n) AS n, sum(prom) AS prom, sum(det) AS det
FROM u WHERE d >= date_sub(current_date(), 14) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'semana', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('week', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), sub, sum(h), sum(bot), sum(n), sum(prom), sum(det)
FROM u WHERE d >= date_sub(CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE), 70) AND d < CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mes', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('month', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), sub, sum(h), sum(bot), sum(n), sum(prom), sum(det)
FROM u GROUP BY 2, 3

WITH tk AS (
  SELECT CAST(created_at_br AS DATE) AS d,
         CASE WHEN lower(vertical) = 'seguros::proteção pix e cartões' THEN 'seg_pix'
              WHEN lower(vertical) = 'seguros::seguro acidente e renda' THEN 'seg_ar'
              WHEN lower(vertical) LIKE 'empréstimo%' AND lower(reason_contact) LIKE '%seguro%' THEN 'seg_emp' END AS sub
  FROM prod.cx.dim_zendesk_tickets_summary
  WHERE flg_human = true AND coalesce(friendly_service_channel, '') <> 'derivacao'
    AND CAST(created_at_br AS DATE) >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5) AND CAST(created_at_br AS DATE) < current_date()
), pol AS (
  SELECT CAST(userid AS STRING) AS u, CASE WHEN plan_id = 'plan-pix-cartao-coacao' THEN 'seg_pix' ELSE 'seg_ar' END AS sub,
         policy_created_at, CAST(policy_created_at AS DATE) AS dc, CAST(cancelled_at AS DATE) AS dx, churn_type, cancellation_requested_by
  FROM prod.checkout.dim_insurance_policy_lifecycle
  WHERE is_test_policy = false AND plan_id IN ('plan-pix-cartao-coacao', 'plan-ap-short-loans-medio', 'plan-ap-renda-protegida')
), emp AS (
  SELECT CAST(accepted_timestamp AS DATE) AS dc, CAST(cancellation_date AS DATE) AS dx, is_regret_period, cancellation_reason
  FROM prod.lending.snap_loan_insurance WHERE is_current = true AND accepted_timestamp IS NOT NULL
), cx AS (
  SELECT CAST(c.ticket_created_timestamp AS DATE) AS d, p.sub, c.is_unauthorized_claim AS contesta,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.ticket_id ORDER BY p.policy_created_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod.checkout.fat_insurance_cx_contact c JOIN pol p ON p.u = CAST(c.user_id AS STRING) AND p.policy_created_at <= c.ticket_created_timestamp
  WHERE c.is_about_insurance = true
), cv AS (
  SELECT created_date AS d, sum(contract_insurance_count) AS n, sum(contract_available_insurance_count) AS dd
  FROM prod.lending.agg_daily_loan_insurance GROUP BY 1
), u AS (
  SELECT d, sub, 1 AS h, 0 AS novas, 0 AS canc, 0 AS arrep, 0 AS contatos, 0 AS contesta, 0 AS conv_n, 0 AS conv_d FROM tk WHERE sub IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT dc, sub, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM pol
  UNION ALL SELECT dx, sub, 0, 0, 1, CASE WHEN churn_type = 'SUSEP_WITHDRAWAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM pol WHERE dx IS NOT NULL AND cancellation_requested_by = 'USER'
  UNION ALL SELECT dc, 'seg_emp', 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM emp
  UNION ALL SELECT dx, 'seg_emp', 0, 0, 1, CASE WHEN is_regret_period THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM emp WHERE dx IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(cancellation_reason, '') <> 'DEBT_SETTLEMENT'
  UNION ALL SELECT d, sub, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, CASE WHEN contesta THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0, 0 FROM cx WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL SELECT d, 'seg_emp', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, n, dd FROM cv
), f AS (
  SELECT * FROM u WHERE d >= add_months(CAST(date_trunc('month', current_date()) AS DATE), -5) AND d < current_date()
)
SELECT 'dia' AS grao, CAST(d AS STRING) AS periodo, sub, sum(h) AS h, sum(novas) AS novas, sum(canc) AS canc, sum(arrep) AS arrep, sum(contatos) AS contatos, sum(contesta) AS contesta, sum(conv_n) AS conv_n, sum(conv_d) AS conv_d
FROM f WHERE d >= date_sub(current_date(), 14) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'semana', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('week', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), sub, sum(h), sum(novas), sum(canc), sum(arrep), sum(contatos), sum(contesta), sum(conv_n), sum(conv_d)
FROM f WHERE d >= date_sub(CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE), 70) AND d < CAST(date_trunc('week', current_date()) AS DATE) GROUP BY 2, 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mes', CAST(CAST(date_trunc('month', d) AS DATE) AS STRING), sub, sum(h), sum(novas), sum(canc), sum(arrep), sum(contatos), sum(contesta), sum(conv_n), sum(conv_d)
FROM f GROUP BY 2, 3
